# OptionCard

A radio choice with a description, for a few options that each need explaining (Admin's sign-up mode: Closed, Invite only, Approval, Open).

`TVTracker.OptionCard` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx

```

```html

```

## Notes

A radio choice with a description line, stacked in a role="radiogroup" (Admin's sign-up mode).
